title: After-School Clubs
text: After school, I join the art club every Tuesday. We do drawing and painting together. My best friend loves singing and dancing in the choir. On weekends, my dad enjoys gardening in our small garden, and my mom likes cooking new dishes. My hobby is photography, so I take pictures of flowers and birds.
